tickerText: [TENNIS] Monday China Open semis in Beijing: Novak Djokovic (32-0 in Beijing) faces Daniil Medvedev after a 4-6, 6-4, 6-4 QF win over Alexander Zverev; Alex de Minaur plays Hubert Hurkacz after both rallied in three-set quarter-finals • Japan Open: Carlos Alcaraz reaches the semis when Denis Shapovalov retires with a hip injury at 7-6(3), 2-1 • [SQUASH] Egyptian double at the Champion Fiberglass Swedish Open in Stockholm: Fayrouz Aboelkheir beat Georgina Kennedy 11-4, 11-5, 11-3 (first Egyptian women's champ); Mohamad Zakaria topped Joel Makin 11-6, 11-6, 8-11, 11-2 • [BADMINTON] VICTOR BWF World Junior Team Championships for the Suhandinata Cup open in Cairo—47 mixed teams, nine from Africa, under new best-of-three relay sets to 55 points • [PICKLEBALL] Rate Las Vegas Open closes Oct. 4 with 1,000-point champions crowned in all five draws at Darling Tennis Center after Ben Johns' singles run and Anna Leigh Waters' push toward 200 career PPA titles • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT China Smash day five at Shougang Park: men's and women's doubles round of 24 plus singles round of 64 in the $2.05M season finale

newsItems.title: Djokovic Extends Perfect Beijing Run
newsItems.excerpt: Novak Djokovic improved to 32-0 in Beijing with a 4-6, 6-4, 6-4 China Open quarter-final win over Alexander Zverev and meets Daniil Medvedev in Monday's semis while Alex de Minaur and Hubert Hurkacz complete the final four.

newsItems.title: Vegas Open Crowns Five Champions
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Rate Las Vegas Open finished Oct. 4 at Darling Tennis Center with 1,000-point titles in every division after a week of upsets—notably Ben Johns (19) in men's singles and Anna Leigh Waters chasing career PPA win No. 200 in doubles.

newsItems.title: China Smash Hits Doubles Day
newsItems.excerpt: WTT China Smash 2026 moves through day five on Oct. 5 at Beijing's Shougang Park with men's and women's doubles round of 24 and more singles round-of-64 matches in the last Grand Smash of the season.

newsItems.title: Junior Team Cup Opens In Cairo
newsItems.excerpt: The VICTOR BWF World Junior Team Championships for the Suhandinata Cup run Oct. 5–10 in Cairo—the sport's second African host—with 47 nations and a revised relay format: best of three sets, each set to 55 points.
